ios.desc:
Snap a photo and turn a thrift find into a fee-aware resale decision.

Underpriced helps resellers identify items, review available market evidence, estimate selling costs and potential profit, and decide whether to flip, research further, or pass.

SCAN, SEARCH, OR USE A SCREENSHOT
• Take a photo or choose one from your library
• Scan a barcode for packaged items, books, and media
• Upload screenshots from online listings
• Add more photos when tags, model numbers, condition, or flaws matter
• Use Estimate Only when you already know the item
• Analyze several finds in parallel with Batch Mode on eligible plans

SOLD COMPS & MARKET EVIDENCE
• Review available sold and active comparable listings
• Separate closer matches from lower-confidence results
• See an estimated market range and data-confidence indicator
• Refine the comps query when the first match needs improvement

Comparable-listing availability varies by item, marketplace, region, and plan.

FEE-AWARE PROFIT CALCULATOR
• Enter your source price and choose a selling scenario
• Estimate selling fees, shipping, promotion costs, and an optional tax reserve
• See estimated net profit, ROI, margin, and suggested list price
• Get a 0–100 Deal Score with a Flip It, Potential Flip, or Pass verdict
• Adjust the inputs to compare different scenarios

DUE DILIGENCE & NEGOTIATION
• Surface suspicious pricing, missing details, condition concerns, and authenticity questions
• Review item-specific checks before committing to a purchase
• Generate negotiation guidance and offer strategies

Risk signals are research prompts, not scam-detection or authentication guarantees.

AI LISTING DRAFTS
Turn completed research into ready-to-copy listing content:
• Generate titles and descriptions for supported selling channels
• Include relevant item details, condition notes, and pricing guidance
• Edit and save drafts before publishing them yourself

Underpriced creates drafts; it does not automatically post listings.

PHOTO STUDIO
• Remove or replace backgrounds
• Mark visible flaws for transparent listings
• Resize and organize photos for your selling workflow

FLIP TRACKER
• Save promising finds and purchase details
• Track Inventory → Listed → Sold
• Record final sales and calculate actual profit
• Review inventory, investment, and profit reports
• Export your data for your records

FLIPEXPERT
Ask an AI reseller assistant about sourcing, pricing, shipping, negotiation, listing strategy, and general reseller workflows. I
